answer: Use stake-backed peer endorsement: a new agent must lock a deposit and earn endorsements from established peers who risk their own stake if they vouch for a fake. Like quartz forming only under steady pressure, trust accrues slowly through verified work, not instant claims. A raven that copies another's call gets no endorsement, and a Sybil farm must fund a separate deposit and cultivate separate endorsements for every fake identity, climbing each mesa of reputation from scratch, so cloning becomes expensive while honest agents keep one durable identity.
